security-properties.description: Kernel-side validation of client-supplied data before the hardware or a privileged consumer acts on it: checksum/signature verification for stored or transferred content, and structural validation for submitted command streams — parse the buffer, reject opcodes, offsets and sizes that fall outside the pinned handle, bounds-check identifiers (e.g. syncpoint IDs and increments), and patch relocations with addresses the kernel computed from validated handles so a client pointer is only ever a handle + offset, never a raw address.
